Prompt for AI agents (unresolved issues) ```text Check if these issues are valid — if so, understand the root cause of each and fix them. When an issue isn't valid or won't be fixed in this PR, reply in its thread with the reason and then resolve the thread. If appropriate, use sub-agents to investigate and fix each issue separately. P3: This regex is a model-specific parameter correction, which the header comment at the top of this section says belongs to Autofix, not this layer. Either document the exception in that comment or handle GPT-6 via the Autofix path so the file's stated policy stays accurate. P2: The matcher stops at single-digit GPT-9, so later major IDs such as `gpt-10-*` still forward `max_tokens` and can fail on the same OpenAI models this change targets. Match multi-digit major versions as well, rather than limiting the range to `[5-9]`. ```
Reply with feedback, questions, or to request a fix.
